CustomField.formula: Total_Loan_Balance_Amount__c + Interest_Accrued_Since_Last_Payment__c + IF(AND(NOT(ISPICKVAL(CurrencyIsoCode, "NZD")), OR(UPPER(Account.Territory_Number__r.Company_Name__c) = "R4K SERVICES PTY LTD", UPPER(Account.Territory_Number__r.Company_Name__c) = "NAASH PTY LTD")), Unpaid_Interest_Amount__c, 0)
CustomField.description: The amount to pay the agreement out today: account balance (principal and fees) + interest charged in earlier periods and not yet paid + interest accrued daily since the last payment. No future interest. Unpaid interest is added only for Australian agreements of R4K Services and Naash; NZ and other companies are unchanged.
CustomField.label: Final Payout Figure
